name: 22202 · Arlington, VA
findings: ZIP 22202 (Arlington) has 201 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22202 (Arlington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
